verdict.rationale: A card-issuing platform with a Customer Area could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this story applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Transaction rules, relayed authorisation and the llms.txt documentation file are automation or AI-readable docs, not a built-in AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
